_ordering_rationale: Monster Energy Drinks d'abord (cœur métier, ~93% CA), puis Strategic Brands (portefeuille Coca 2015), puis Alcohol Brands (CANarchy 2022), puis ventes internationales (relais croissance).

kpis.name_en: Monster Energy Drinks Segment Net Sales
kpis.signal: Cœur métier Monster (~93% CA FY25), marque #2 mondial energy drinks, croissance soutenue malgré marché mature US
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Monster Energy Drinks : marque iconique Monster® et déclinaisons (Ultra, Reign, Java). Cœur de métier ~93% du CA FY25, distribution via Coca-Cola.
kpis.description_en: Monster Energy Drinks segment net sales: iconic Monster® brand and extensions (Ultra, Reign, Java). Core business ~93% FY25 revenue, distributed via Coca-Cola.

kpis.signal: Portefeuille marques internationales rachetées à Coca (NOS, Burn, Predator), forte croissance émergents
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Strategic Brands : portefeuille international (Predator®, Burn®, NOS®, Relentless, Mother) acquis de Coca-Cola en 2015. Croissance soutenue marchés émergents.
kpis.description_en: Strategic Brands segment net sales: international portfolio (Predator®, Burn®, NOS®, Relentless, Mother) acquired from Coca-Cola in 2015. Strong emerging markets growth.

kpis.signal: Segment alcool (CANarchy acq. Feb 2022) en repli depuis FY23 (-21.8% FY25), sous-performance vs énergie
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Alcohol Brands : bières craft, hard seltzers (Beast Unleashed, Nasty Beast), issus acquisition CANarchy février 2022. FY21 = 0 (avant acquisition). En recul depuis FY23.
kpis.description_en: Alcohol Brands segment net sales: craft beers, hard seltzers (Beast Unleashed, Nasty Beast), from CANarchy Feb 2022 acquisition. FY21 = 0 (pre-acquisition). Declining since FY23.

kpis.signal: Internationalisation accélérée (+16.2% FY25 vs +11.7% Monster Drinks total), relais croissance hors marché US mature
kpis.description_fr: Ventes nettes hors États-Unis. Relais de croissance principal compte tenu de la maturité du marché énergisant US. Historique FY21/FY22 non publié dans les 10-K consultés.
kpis.description_en: Net sales outside the United States. Primary growth driver given US energy drinks market maturity. FY21/FY22 not disclosed in consulted 10-K filings.
